plugins.description: A growing repertoire of self-authored Claude Code skills — conductor-style subagent pipelines that carry an idea from discovery through spec, plan, build, PR-review closure, post-ship enhancement, and debugging — plus a fast lane for scoped changes that need no plan, an autonomous session that finds its own worklist and ships it, and a motion lane that polishes UI animation against a bundled craft bar. More to come.
